newsitem.title: CANADA: Province threatens law to bar Alcan suit.
newsitem.headline: Province threatens law to bar Alcan suit.

text.p: British Columbia may consider enacting legislation to halt a lawsuit by Alcan Aluminium Ltd, Premier Glen Clark said late Monday.

Alcan announced Monday it would go ahead with a lawsuit aimed at winning compensation for its cancelled Kemano hydroelectric project in northern British Columbia. Alcan spent C$535 million on the half-built project before the province killed it for environmental reasons.

Clark told reporters that the government would consider passing legislation that would eliminate Alcan's right to sue. "I've said before it was an option for the government. It was one we're reluctant to use. Unfortunately this court action does push it up a notch and we'll have to consider it," he said.
Negotiations on an out-of-court settlement collapsed on Monday.
